title: How to Do 90% of What Plugins Do (With Just Vim)
summary: A thoughtbot meetup talk by Max Cantor on getting most of what popular plugins provide using only built-in Vim features. It covers autocomplete, file jumping, filesystem navigation, build integration and snippets, with slides and a vimrc available.
why: HN treats it as the canonical talk for the case that vanilla Vim goes a long way and plugin dependencies are a burden.

quote.text: Max Cantor has a great talk about that on YouTube
